messages:
ingrid_cs: Onboard check-in with Zephyr. They hit repeated 429s on browser sdk.init preflight right after creating sessions. 

devon_se: Paste the console/response?

ingrid_cs: Console shows: POST /v1/preflight 429 {"error":"rate_limited"}, header x-rate-limit-reset: 24, x-rw-req: rz-0a7c.

maria_platform: SDK + version? ephemeral or static key?

ingrid_cs: browser-js v0.9.2, ephemeral token flow. QA team opens ~12 tabs in quick succession.

ryan_infra: That many parallel preflight handshakes will trip per-key + per-IP soft limits. Preflight touches token validation and quota checks.

alice_support: Short-term: instruct them to add jitter on init and cache ephemeral per tab. Long-term: adjust client quickstart.

ingrid_cs: They need a short-term unblock, can't change QA workflow now. Any infra options?

devon_se: We can soft-whitelist their org for a limited time or raise the soft window for onboarding. Need approvals and audit.

maria_platform: If approved, keep it time-limited and scoped. Share org id + sample req id.

ingrid_cs: Org: zephyr-inc (org_zeph_338). Req id: rz-0a7c. Region: eu-west-1.

ops_bot: Incident created: CS-ONBOARD-927 by ingrid_cs. Assigned: devon_se, ryan_infra. P2.

ryan_infra: Ask them to send a HAR and a minimal repro (3 tabs) to confirm it's not double-posting or a token-refresh loop.

devon_se: Also note: preflight and generation are separate counters but both contribute to operational throughput. Token refresh loops amplify preflight. Recommend reusing ephemeral tokens for >=2min and backoff.

alice_support: I'll send a KB asking for HAR, env, X-Forwarded-For, SDK version and repro steps.

ingrid_cs: They've attached a HAR shows three preflight posts within 400ms.

maria_platform: That will trip the window. Approve temporary whitelist?

devon_se: I can apply a 2-hour soft-whitelist if maria_platform approves and ops_bot logs audit.

maria_platform: Approved for 2 hours.

ops_bot: Audit: whitelist applied to org_zeph_338 by maria_platform until 1747785200.

alice_support: KB sent to Zephyr, they confirmed QA is unblocked and will adopt token caching after tomorrow's deploy.

ingrid_cs: Closing CS-ONBOARD-927 after customer verifies. Thanks everyone :tada:
